description: Runtime and data side of the fridge stock: a FridgeStockSlot component that spawns one ingredient at its pose at start and respawns it at the same pose 5 seconds after it was taken; a working Mushroom prefab (grab + cook + slice) and a Mushroom entry in the cooking profile so mushrooms really cook; Sliceable on Steak so both ingredients have identical properties; tests. Independent of FEAT-003 in code, but FEAT-003 depends on this feature.
steps: HeldObjectPhysics.cs (Assets/Scripts/Common): extract the per-object criteria of InstallAll into `public static bool TryInstall(XRGrabInteractable grab)` (returns true if the component was added; same rules as today: skip null, skip if HeldObjectPhysics already present, skip if no Rigidbody or kinematic, skip if movementType is not Instantaneous/Kinematic). InstallAll must call it and keep returning the count. Behavior of InstallAll must stay identical; update the XML doc comment. Do not change anything else in that file.

Create Assets/Scripts/Fridge/FridgeStockSlot.cs (+ .cs.meta with a fresh guid, MonoImporter format like Assets/Scripts/Cooking/PanSnap.cs.meta; also Assets/Scripts/Fridge.meta folder meta with a fresh guid, format of Assets/Scripts/Cooking.meta). Global namespace, `public class FridgeStockSlot : MonoBehaviour`, XML doc summary. Serialized fields (m_ prefix, [Tooltip]): GameObject m_Prefab; float m_RespawnDelay = 5f ([Min(0)]); float m_LeaveDistance = 0.12f ([Min(0.01f)]); float m_ClearRadius = 0.1f ([Min(0.01f)], radius of the free-spot check sphere); bool m_SpawnOnStart = true. Public API: `void Configure(GameObject prefab, float respawnDelay = 5f, float clearRadius = 0.1f, float leaveDistance = 0.12f)` for tests and editor builders; `GameObject CurrentItem` (null when the slot is empty/waiting); `bool IsWaitingToRespawn`; `float RespawnDelay`; `GameObject SpawnNow()` (spawns only if the slot is empty, returns the new item or null). Behavior: Start() spawns when m_SpawnOnStart and the slot is empty. Spawn = Instantiate(m_Prefab, transform.position, transform.rotation) with NO parent; zero Rigidbody velocities; call HeldObjectPhysics.TryInstall on the item's XRGrabInteractable; subscribe `grab.selectEntered` (store the interactable to unsubscribe). 'Taken' (private MarkTaken, idempotent): unsubscribe, clear CurrentItem, set waiting with respawnAt = Time.time + m_RespawnDelay. MarkTaken is triggered by: (a) selectEntered of the current item, (b) Update() finding the current item destroyed (Unity null check, e.g. sliced and Destroy()ed), (c) Update() finding the current item farther than m_LeaveDistance from transform.position. Update(): if waiting and Time.time >= respawnAt and IsSpotClear() then Spawn. IsSpotClear = Physics.OverlapSphereNonAlloc (reuse a Collider[16] buffer, QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore) at transform.position + Vector3.up * m_ClearRadius with radius m_ClearRadius; the spot is blocked if any hit collider is enabled, not a trigger and has attachedRigidbody != null (static fridge/shelf colliders do not block; a held or resting loose item does). Guard against spawning while the component is disabled/being destroyed (use isActiveAndEnabled), log one warning and do nothing if m_Prefab is null. Because only the slot holds state, clones made by KnifeSlicer (halves) never trigger spawns. Add OnDrawGizmosSelected drawing the check sphere.

Assets/Data/CookingProfile_Default.asset: append a second entry to m_Entries: kind: 1 (Mushroom), almostDoneAt: 6, cookedAt: 12, burnedAt: 24 (mushrooms burn faster than the steak 10/20/40, as the design docs require), raw: Mushroom_Raw.mat guid 696c8fe9975d4aa2ac5d46971c8c9e14, almostDone: the new Mushroom_AlmostDone.mat, cooked: material guid used by Mushroom_Whole_Cooked.prefab (resolve e27be3af02974ee3892f07f842736e35 to its .mat), burned: material guid used by Mushroom_Whole_Burned.prefab (8d88a3b732ff4c39b88efe2dd12be731). Keep the existing Steak entry untouched, same YAML formatting (fileID 2100000, type 2).

Create Assets/Materials/Ingredients/Mushroom_AlmostDone.mat (+ .mat.meta, NativeFormatImporter with mainObjectFileID 2100000, fresh guid) as a copy of Mushroom_Raw.mat with m_Name Mushroom_AlmostDone and _BaseColor/_Color set to about r 0.4777 g 0.3449 b 0.2335 (halfway between raw and cooked). Keep LF endings, no BOM.

Create Assets/Prefabs/Ingredients/Mushroom.prefab (+ .prefab.meta, PrefabImporter, fresh guid) as a hand-written prefab variant of the FBX prefab guid 9e34622b14123413fa8c97eec453f5d7, by copying Assets/Models/Ingredients/Mushrooms/Mushroom_Whole_Raw.prefab (same PrefabInstance structure: scale 0.15, material Mushroom_Raw, Rigidbody mass 0.05 ContinuousDynamic+Interpolate, bare XRGrabInteractable, convex MeshCollider) with: root m_Name value `Mushroom`; a new unique PrefabInstance fileID and new unique fileIDs for the copied added components; two extra MonoBehaviour docs on the stripped root GameObject (m_AddedComponents entries with targetCorrespondingSourceObject {fileID: 919132149155446097, guid: 9e34622b14123413fa8c97eec453f5d7}): Cookable (m_Script guid 79cfbdbe864ca434b80c326b74a4e176, m_EditorClassIdentifier LoveAtFirstBite.Runtime::Cookable, m_Kind: 1, m_Profile {fileID: 11400000, guid: 5b82802525f63734d97a2aae3925f1b2, type: 2}, m_TargetRenderer {fileID: 0}) and Sliceable (m_Script guid 5bbe56b96d551f34fbce786d36908e46, m_EditorClassIdentifier LoveAtFirstBite.Runtime::LoveAtFirstBite.Slicing.Sliceable, maxCuts: 2, cutsSoFar: 0). Compare field-by-field against Assets/Prefabs/Ingredients/Steak.prefab for the Cookable doc layout.

Assets/Prefabs/Ingredients/Steak.prefab: add a Sliceable (same field values as above) the same way: new unique MonoBehaviour fileID, an extra m_AddedComponents entry targeting the Steak_Raw root GameObject {fileID: 6452987395473004570, guid: 1c916d98b7c349529febac66b6ca5836}, referencing the existing stripped GameObject 8103892448992198673 in m_GameObject. Do not change anything else in that file.

Write PlayMode tests Assets/Scripts/Tests/PlayMode/FridgeStockSlotTests.cs (reuse the harness idea of HeldObjectPhysicsTests: XRInteractionManager + `class TestInteractor : XRBaseInteractor`, SelectEnter/SelectExit through the manager; build a tiny item prefab in code: inactive GameObject with BoxCollider, Rigidbody, XRGrabInteractable (Instantaneous), then set the slot inactive, Configure(prefab, respawnDelay: 0.3f, ...), activate). Static box under the slot as a 'shelf'. Cases: (1) item exists at slot pose after Start and is grabbable (has HeldObjectPhysics after spawn); (2) default RespawnDelay of a freshly added component is 5; (3) grabbing the item does not respawn before the delay, and respawns exactly one new item at the slot pose after the delay (count items with the test tag/name: exactly 2 in the scene, the taken one is not at the slot pose when moved away); (4) if the taken item is still held on the spot after the delay, no new item spawns until it is moved away (distance/overlap) and then exactly one spawns; (5) destroying the item (as the slicer does) triggers one respawn; (6) a Object.Instantiate clone of the item that is then grabbed (like a slicer half) does NOT cause an extra spawn; (7) moving the untouched item farther than leaveDistance triggers a respawn; (8) only one respawn per taking, even over a long wait. Use short real-time delays (0.3 s) with `yield return new WaitForSeconds`, and clean up with TearDown like the other tests.

Write EditMode tests Assets/Scripts/Tests/EditMode/IngredientAssetsTests.cs (Editor-only asmdef, may use UnityEditor.AssetDatabase and SerializedObject): (a) CookingProfile_Default.asset loaded from Assets/Data/CookingProfile_Default.asset passes Validate() and has an entry for EVERY IngredientKind value (Enum.GetValues), with the Mushroom thresholds strictly lower than the Steak ones; (b) Assets/Prefabs/Ingredients/Steak.prefab and Mushroom.prefab each have Cookable (Kind Steak / Mushroom, serialized m_Profile non-null via SerializedObject), Sliceable, XRGrabInteractable, a non-kinematic Rigidbody, and a Collider in children (LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>, GetComponentInChildren). These tests must fail if the Mushroom entry, Cookable or Sliceable were removed.

Run compile_check.ps1 (runtime + EditMode + PlayMode) and fix every error. Then run a python YAML integrity check on Mushroom.prefab, Steak.prefab, CookingProfile_Default.asset and Mushroom_AlmostDone.mat (split on '--- !u!<class> &<fileID>', unique fileIDs, every added component id from m_AddedComponents has a doc, every referenced guid exists as a .meta in Assets, new guids unique) and record the output in findings.
